name: AN-23-067-2017-representative-likelihood-v1
notes: The nominal reference MC support target is the AN section 4.5 maximum relative statistical uncertainty of 17.5%, equivalent to at least 1/0.175^2 effective background events per signal-populated bin.
One 2017 region is fit at a time, matching AN section 7; no invented ABCD transfer factor or simultaneous SR/control constraint.
Normalization uncertainties and QCD blanket coefficient are copied from the AN. The AN does not specify numerical ST PDF/scale lnN amplitudes; these are deliberately not invented.
Shape nuisance identifiers define this export interface. Correlations follow the AN; exact spelling for names absent from the note is local, not a claim to have obtained the private cards.
CMS_jec_Total_2017 is an accepted approximate supplied variation, but never satisfies the seven required source-specific JEC templates.
Absent audited Beeston-Barlow coefficients, QCD-only finite MC enters beta, while all other process/bin variances remain separate Gaussian nuisance factors.

No theory normalization uncertainty is applied to the chosen signal cross section; the signal strength r scales that benchmark, so a bound on r converts to a bound on the same cross-section convention.
